title: Technical Product Manager - Gateway
description: Valor PayTech fosters a vibrant and nurturing work atmosphere that motivates employees to innovate and excel. The culture is deeply rooted in collaboration and ongoing development, offering team members abundant opportunities for professional advancement and skill improvement. Emphasizing innovation excellence and cultural expansion, the company greatly values the diversity of its workforce, believing it to be a cornerstone of its success. Role Overview Valor PayTech is hiring a Technical Product Manager to own the internal software development lifecycle for our Valor Gateway and Portal — the system of record that powers the entire Credit card processing, Payment Gateway, POS Terminals, SWITCH processing, ECOM Channel, Virtual terminal including ACH capability, and ISVs support. This is a hands-on, in-the-weeds role for someone who thrives at the intersection of product, process, and engineering execution. You will report directly to the Senior Technical Product Manager and act as the operational and technical backbone of the Gateway’s roadmap — translating business priorities into clear, complete engineering requirements, managing sprint execution, and ensuring releases are delivered with quality and on schedule. Above all, this role owns the discipline of getting analysis right the first time : before a change reaches engineering, you are accountable for enumerating its full impact across the platform, so that what we build is consistent, complete, and free of the gaps that surface late in production. This role does not require coding ability, but candidates with hands-on technical fluency (SQL, scripting, API / data literacy) will be considered a strong asset given the complexity of the systems involved. What We’re Looking For Four qualities define success in this role: A Self-Starter and Owner — You take end-to-end ownership of your platform’s SDLC without waiting to be directed. You drive backlog, analysis, and releases forward, chase down open questions across teams, and treat every gap between intent and delivery as yours to close. Technically Fluent — You are comfortable in the details of a complex payments platform — transaction flows, data models, integrations, and configuration — and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers and QA. You reason about systems, not just features. Rigorous and Complete — You do not stop at the happy path. Before a change is committed, you systematically map its full impact surface — every transaction type, user persona, device population, credential form, processing feature, integration rail, and configuration state it could touch — so nothing is silently left behind. Completeness of analysis is the single most important thing this role protects. A Strong Executor and Communicator — You run disciplined agile ceremonies, write specifications engineering can build against without guessing, and communicate clearly with a US-based team — turning business and compliance needs into precise, unambiguous requirements. What You’ll Own SDLC Ownership and Delivery End-to-end SDLC management for Valor Gateway and Portal — backlog grooming, sprint planning, release coordination, and go-live sign-off, working closely with engineering leads and QA. Project estimation and resource planning, partnering with the Senior Technical Product Manager on scoping, prioritization, and developer-day forecasting. Release documentation, including change logs, workflow enhancement specs, and cross-processor integration notes. Own phase one of the SDLC — analysis and requirements gathering — as the point where quality is decided. For every change, enumerate the complete impact surface before engineering commits. Facilitate pre-commitment reviews with engineering and QA — a shared walkthrough of scope and impact before build begins. Translate business and compliance requirements into detailed technical specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineering can execute against without ambiguity. Platform Domain: Valor Payment Gateway and ISV Project Understanding Valor Payment Gateway capabilities and work towards offering them for the ISVs Handling ISVs requirements, lining up for work Prioritize based on the feasibility and the market value What You’ll Bring 7+ years of experience in technical product management, product ownership, or a closely related role, ideally within fintech, payments, banking, or merchant services. Proven experience managing a software development lifecycle: writing requirements, grooming backlogs, running agile ceremonies, and coordinating releases with engineering teams. Demonstrated rigor in requirements analysis — a track record of thinking through the full scope of a change and its edge cases up front, rather than discovering them after release. Strong analytical and process-design skills, with comfort interpreting data to monitor transactional and non-transactional activity. High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with a US-based team and accurately translate their business requirements into clear PRDs and project plans. Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., for documentation, analysis, or workflow automation) as part of regular product management practice. A collaborative work style and willingness to work a hybrid schedule from Valor PayTech’s Chennai office. Experience reporting to or partnering closely with a Product Owner in a structured product organization. Nice to Have (Strong Bonus) US Payment Knowledge, credit card processing and working on ISV products POS machines development, APP building, API integration Web Apps development and payment integration Familiarity with payments infrastructure and terminology — processors (such as TSYS, Fiserv), ACH / NACHA, ISO 8583, PCI DSS — gained through hands-on product or technical work. Big plus – but not required. Working knowledge of SQL for querying transaction, settlement, or merchant data. Scripting ability (e.g., Python) to support data analysis, automation, or reporting tasks. Exposure to REST APIs, JSON / XML data structures, or systems integration concepts. Prior experience with risk / fraud monitoring tools or chargeback and dispute workflows. Certifications such as CSPO, PMI-ACP, or processor-specific training (e.g., TSYS University). Why Join Valor PayTech You’ll take ownership of a mission-critical platform that touches every stage of the Valor payment gateway and ISV relationship, working alongside a focused product and engineering team in our Chennai office. This is an opportunity to shape how a fast-growing Payment gateway integrating with ISVs to utilize our feature — and to set the standard for how analysis and requirements are done — with direct visibility into the Product and broader leadership team.

Strong experience in hydrodynamic and wave modelling using MIKE21 (2D) and MIKE3 (3D), including HD, SW and BW modules, preferably for the design of ports, harbours and coastal structures. Experience with MIKE environmental modules, including sediment and mud transport, particle tracking, LITPACK and 2D/3D dispersion modelling for EIA, sedimentation, dredge spill, brine and plume dispersion studies Proficiency in Python, MATLAB or similar tools for automation, data processing and engineering workflows. Strong report-writing skills and ability to independently deliver technical reports, technical proposals and financial proposals. Ability to lead technical assignments, work independently and collaboratively, plan and schedule deliverables, perform self-checks and QA of reports/modelling work, mentor and train team members, and demonstrate strong written and verbal communication skills. A place to work and so much more At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and livable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home. With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their skills in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play. title: Welding Specialist

Ability to interpret engineering drawings, welding symbols, and customer specifications. Preferred Certifications CSWIP / AWS / IWE / IWT certification preferred. Lead client calls, campaign discussions, requirement-gathering workshops, solution reviews and delivery/status meetings. Provide recommendations to clients on campaign/journey design and marketing automation best practices. Communicate risks, dependencies, blockers and implementation considerations proactively. Coordinate with client-side Marketing, Product, Data, Analytics, Technology and other relevant stakeholders. Manage stakeholder expectations while maintaining delivery quality and timelines. Strong recent hands-on Braze experience, ideally leading enterprise-scale implementations. Demonstrated experience building complex Braze Canvas journeys and campaigns. Experience delivering campaigns across Email, SMS and Mobile App/Push channels. Strong understanding of: Lifecycle marketing Cross-channel orchestration Customer segmentation Personalization Event/trigger-based campaigns Dynamic content Experimentation/testing Campaign QA and deployment Experience managing a 10+ member delivery team. Strong client-facing experience, including requirements gathering, solution discussions and status/governance calls. Preferred Qualifications Experience in Banking, Financial Services, FinTech or another regulated industry. Prior experience with other marketing platforms in addition to Braze. Experience transitioning marketing automation programs from Bird to Braze would be highly valuable. Understanding of marketing/customer data integration patterns. Familiarity with APIs, webhooks, event-based data, customer attributes and real-time campaign triggers. Experience running large-scale campaign operations and establishing campaign governance frameworks. Braze certifications or relevant marketing automation/platform certifications would be advantageous.

title: SFDC Architect
description: We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Solution Architect with 10+ years of experience to lead the design, development, and evolution of enterprise Salesforce solutions supporting global B2B and B2C business operations.The ideal candidate will combine strong solution architecture capabilities with hands-on Salesforce technical expertise. The role requires someone who can translate complex business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions, guide development teams, make sound architectural decisions, and write or debug code when required.The architect will work across multiple Salesforce applications, external enterprise systems, country-specific business processes, and cross-functional technology teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise architecture standards and long-term business objectives. Key Responsibilities1. Solution Architecture and Design Own end-to-end Salesforce solution architecture, from requirements discovery through design, implementation, deployment, and production support. Translate business requirements into scalable Salesforce architectures, technical designs, data models, integration patterns, and implementation roadmaps. Evaluate standard Salesforce capabilities, configuration, declarative automation, custom development, and external services to recommend the most appropriate solution. Define architectural standards, reusable components, coding guidelines, design patterns, and technical best practices. Assess the impact of proposed changes on existing applications, integrations, business processes, and future enhancements. Identify technical risks, scalability constraints, platform limitations, and opportunities for simplification. 2. Hands-on Salesforce Development Write, review, debug, and optimize Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL, and other Salesforce customizations when required. Develop proof-of-concepts and technical prototypes to validate architectural decisions and resolve complex technical challenges. Demonstrate strong understanding of Apex triggers, asynchronous processing, Batch Apex, Queueable Apex, platform events, transaction management, and governor limits. Ensure code follows bulkification, security, exception-handling, testability, and performance best practices. Review complex implementations and guide developers in resolving technical issues. Participate directly in critical development activities, production troubleshooting, and performance optimization when necessary. 3. Salesforce Data Modeling and Governance Design scalable Salesforce data models using standard and custom objects, appropriate relationships, and well-defined ownership and sharing strategies. Define data mastership, external identifiers, deduplication, matching, data migration, and reconciliation approaches. Design data models that support global customer identities, B2B relationships, B2C customer journeys, and country-specific business requirements. Ensure appropriate data access, privacy, auditability, and regulatory considerations are incorporated into the architecture. 4. Integration Architecture Design and govern integrations between Salesforce and enterprise platforms such as SAP, customer portals, identity providers, middleware, and marketing platforms. Define suitable integration patterns using REST/SOAP APIs, event-driven architecture, asynchronous processing, and middleware where appropriate. Address authentication, authorization, idempotency, retries, error handling, monitoring, reconciliation, and integration resilience. Collaborate with enterprise integration and platform teams to manage dependencies, API contracts, release sequencing, and system-wide changes. 5. Global Platform and Release Governance Support a global Salesforce platform operating across multiple countries and business markets. Balance global architecture standards with legitimate local business and regulatory requirements. Evaluate the impact of changes across countries, applications, integrations, and downstream systems before approving designs. Coordinate with business stakeholders, development teams, QA, DevOps, security, and platform teams to ensure controlled delivery. Contribute to release planning, technical risk assessments, environment strategy, deployment readiness, and production stability. Prevent unnecessary customization and architectural fragmentation across markets. 6. Technical Leadership and Team Enablement Provide technical direction and architectural guidance to Salesforce developers, technical leads, QA engineers, and integration teams. Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, design walkthroughs, and technical knowledge-sharing sessions. Establish development standards and reusable patterns that improve code quality, maintainability, and developer productivity. Mentor team members and support technical decision-making across distributed teams. Communicate architectural decisions, trade-offs, risks, and recommendations clearly to both technical and business stakeholders. 7. Platform Evolution and Continuous Improvement Evaluate new Salesforce capabilities and recommend adoption based on business value, technical fit, and platform strategy. Identify opportunities to improve performance, reduce technical debt, simplify integrations, and optimize delivery costs. Contribute to Salesforce platform roadmaps and long-term architecture decisions. Support production incident analysis and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurring issues. Required Technical Skills Strong expertise in Salesforce Sales Cloud and Experience Cloud. Hands-on experience with Apex, Triggers, LWC, SOQL, Salesforce security, and declarative automation. Strong understanding of Salesforce data modeling, sharing and visibility, governor limits, transaction boundaries, and platform architecture. Experience designing enterprise integrations using REST/SOAP APIs and asynchronous or event-driven patterns. Understanding of integration resilience, error handling, monitoring, data reconciliation, and API security. Experience with Salesforce deployments, source control, CI/CD, and release management. Familiarity with enterprise identity and access management, SSO, OAuth, and external identity solutions. Ability to diagnose complex technical issues and validate architectural decisions through working code or prototypes. Preferred Experience Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud and customer engagement integrations. Exposure to Salesforce Data Cloud and/or Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud. Experience with SAP or other ERP integrations. Experience with middleware and integration platforms such as MuleSoft, SnapLogic, Informatica, or equivalent technologies. Experience with multi-country Salesforce implementations and global platform governance. Experience with Experience Cloud portals, external users, customer identity, and large-scale customer data management. Familiarity with consent management, customer data privacy, and market-specific regulatory requirements. Experience and Qualifications Typically 10+ years of Salesforce or relevant enterprise CRM experience. Demonstrated experience owning solution architecture for complex Salesforce implementations. Proven experience leading technical teams and collaborating across business and technology functions. Salesforce Application Architect certification preferred; System Architect or relevant advanced certifications are an advantage. Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, and problem-solving skills. Success Criteria The successful candidate will be expected to: Deliver scalable and maintainable architecture aligned with enterprise standards. Make defensible design decisions with clear consideration of alternatives, risks, and trade-offs. Independently validate critical technical designs through code, prototypes, debugging, and code reviews. Minimize regression risk across existing systems, integrations, and country implementations. Improve engineering standards and enable development teams to deliver consistently. Maintain a balance between architectural leadership and hands-on technical contribution. Role Expectation This is an architecture-led role with hands-on technical responsibilities. The candidate is not expected to spend every day implementing features, but must be capable of independently writing and debugging Apex and related Salesforce code when complex technical challenges, critical issues, or architectural validation require it. Pay: ₹3,000,000.00 - ₹4,000,000.00 per year Work Location: In person

The role focuses on GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, self-hosted runner infrastructure, cross-platform build and deployment automation, and reliable delivery of on-premises software across Windows, Linux, and macOS environments, with supporting Azure services. This position requires strong technical ownership of automation, infrastructure reliability, release engineering, and deployment troubleshooting across distributed engineering environments. The engineer will work closely with software development, QA, IT, infrastructure, and global engineering teams to establish scalable, secure, and repeatable software delivery practices. Key Responsibilities Design, implement, and maintain end-to-end CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Enterprise Server and GitHub Actions for multiple software products and repositories. Architect and manage self-hosted GitHub Actions runners across Windows, Linux, and macOS, including runner PCs used for hardware-dependent testing, integration, and deployment. Automate software build, unit testing, integration testing, packaging, artifact management, release, installation, and deployment workflows. Develop reusable GitHub Actions workflows, composite actions, scripts, and shared pipeline components to standardize engineering practices across teams. Design and maintain cross-platform deployment automation for on-premises applications, services, tools, and supporting infrastructure. Implement automated deployment, configuration management, environment provisioning, upgrade, rollback, and recovery procedures for customer and internal environments. Manage runner lifecycle, capacity, labels, groups, access controls, service accounts, credentials, connectivity, and job execution reliability. Build and maintain deployment automation using Bash, PowerShell, Python, and other appropriate scripting technologies. Integrate Azure services into software delivery workflows, including identity, secrets management, artifact storage, infrastructure provisioning, and monitoring, as applicable. Implement secure software supply chain practices, including least-privilege access, secret management, dependency and vulnerability scanning, artifact integrity, and controlled release approvals. Establish infrastructure-as-code and configuration-as-code practices using appropriate tools, including Terraform, Bicep, or equivalent technologies where applicable. Design CI/CD pipelines that support automated quality gates, test result publishing, code coverage, static analysis, security checks, and release readiness validation. Monitor pipeline health, runner availability, deployment outcomes, and infrastructure capacity; troubleshoot failures across GitHub, operating systems, networking, permissions, and application dependencies. Establish deployment observability, actionable logging, alerts, operational dashboards, and incident recovery procedures for on-premises environments. Manage release versioning, artifact traceability, environment configuration, release promotion, and deployment auditability across independently evolving software components. Collaborate with software and QA teams to improve build times, test reliability, deployment frequency, and developer productivity. Lead technical reviews, mentor engineers, document operational procedures, and drive continuous improvement in DevOps standards and practices. Work directly with global engineering teams during software integration, customer deployments, production issues, and release support. Requirements: 7+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, build and release engineering, or infrastructure automation, with demonstrated technical ownership. Strong hands-on expertise with GitHub Enterprise Server, GitHub Actions, workflow design, reusable workflows, runner management, and GitHub APIs. Technically Fluent — You are comfortable in the details of a complex payments platform — transaction flows, data models, integrations, and configuration — and can hold a credible technical conversation with engineers and QA. Demonstrated rigor in requirements analysis — a track record of thinking through the full scope of a change and its edge cases up front, rather than discovering them after release. Strong analytical and process-design skills, with comfort interpreting data to monitor transactional and non-transactional activity. High proficiency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate effectively with a US-based team and accurately translate their business requirements into clear PRDs and project plans. Demonstrated comfort using AI tools (e.g., for documentation, analysis, or workflow automation) as part of regular product management practice. A collaborative work style and willingness to work a hybrid schedule from Valor PayTech’s Chennai office. Experience reporting to or partnering closely with a Product Owner in a structured product organization. Nice to Have (Strong Bonus) US Payment Knowledge, credit card processing and working on ISV products POS machines development, APP building, API integration Web Apps development and payment integration Familiarity with payments infrastructure and terminology — processors (such as TSYS, Fiserv), ACH / NACHA, ISO 8583, PCI DSS — gained through hands-on product or technical work. Big plus – but not required. Working knowledge of SQL for querying transaction, settlement, or merchant data. Scripting ability (e.g., Python) to support data analysis, automation, or reporting tasks. Exposure to REST APIs, JSON / XML data structures, or systems integration concepts. Prior experience with risk / fraud monitoring tools or chargeback and dispute workflows. Certifications such as CSPO, PMI-ACP, or processor-specific training (e.g., TSYS University). Why Join Valor PayTech You’ll take ownership of a mission-critical platform that touches every stage of the Valor payment gateway and ISV relationship, working alongside a focused product and engineering team in our Chennai office. Ability to troubleshoot complex failures spanning source control, build agents, operating systems, networking, application dependencies, and deployment environments. Experience owning infrastructure and automation solutions from design through implementation, rollout, and operational support.

description: Software Technical Lead Job title: Software Technical Lead Location: Chennai, Tamil Nadu Work model: Primarily Office Based Reporting to: Engineering Manager Team size: Initially 4–7 software engineers, with close collaboration across QA, DevOps/platform engineering, and firmware/hardware-adjacent teams About the role ePropelled develops intelligent propulsion and power management systems for uncrewed vehicles. Your strongest experience will be in software development, backend services and full-stack delivery. You will bring strong production development skills in Python or Java, experience delivering containerised services, and practical exposure to IoT, telemetry or other connected-device systems. You will lead technical decisions, contribute code and help other engineers deliver reliable software. Edge gateways, Linux-based devices or systems that operate with unreliable connectivity. PostgreSQL, time-series data or telemetry storage and processing.
